entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I... I think I need to return something? I'm just so confused by the website.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can definitely help you look into a return today.
Oh, thank you. It's a helmet I bought a while ago.
I can certainly check on that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
A preference, I guess? The color isn't what my son wanted for his gift. I'm just looking at it now. I'm so overwhelmed. The box is still unopened. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I understand. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your order details. I see the helmet was delivered 74 days ago. Let me check the policy for you.
74 days? Oh no, is that too long? I don't understand all these rules.

Not at all. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. So you are well within the window for a full refund. We want to make sure everyone has the right gear for their safety, so getting the correct color is important.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! That's such a relief. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I am sending you a pre-paid return shipping label to your email on file right now. You just need to print that, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at the post office.
Okay, I see the email. That's perfect. You've made this so easy.
I'm glad I could help. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Charlie.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
